newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas falls across the board in busy trade.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas falls across the board in busy trade.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures headed lower on Wednesday with trade active in nearly all months across the forward curve.
Traded volumes totalled 495 lots, considerably heavier than recent volumes, but off the record high for the contract of 575 lots.
"It was unusually busy today and nearly everything traded which was nice," said one broker.
The front month May slipped by 0.150 pence a therm (p/th) to 10.00 p/th, having failed to breach resistance at 10.25 p/th earlier in the week.
The first quarter 1998 was also actively traded, with traders taking advantage of sliding quotes to lock in winter gas.
"It looks like the shorts were tired of being short and came in as prices fell -- but not in big enough numbers to turn things around," said one dealer.
January shed 0.230 p/th to end the session at 16.20 p/th, while February fell 0.210 p/th to 16.30 p/th.
Earlier, the IPE busted a trade on January at 16 p/th, after a broker entered a bid as an offer in error, leading its client to pick up its own offer.
